$comment: SSOT for what the workflow checks. criteria.md is the human-readable view of THIS file. The orchestrator selects rows by scope+phase and dispatches one voxel-plan-reviewer agent per row (criterion_id). Each row's `predicate` is the machine-checkable pass condition; `evidence` is the command/source the agent runs to gather proof. Add/remove/retune a check by editing a row here — never the pipeline. Severity: C=Critical (blocks the gate), I=Improvement (needs a reconciliation outcome), K=Cosmetic.

criteria.criterion: Every field with data on the sample is surfaced in some section, or carries an omit:<reason> that survives challenge.
criteria.evidence: wpdev voxel:fields + §2a Field Inventory + sampled voxel:data
criteria.predicate: set(fields_with_data) ⊆ set(fields_bound ∪ fields_omitted_with_valid_reason)

criteria.criterion: Plan section/widget count matches what the CPT data shape supports, judged against peer templates.
criteria.predicate: plan.section_count >= peer_median OR every below-median section has a justification line

criteria.criterion: Every post-relation field with data is surfaced AND its traversals appear in a blueprint.
criteria.predicate: ∀ relation r with data: r surfaced AND ∃ blueprint cell using @post(r.<field>)

criteria.criterion: Exactly one tag:main root; exactly one h1 (hero, title-bound); document order is a valid h1→h2→h3 outline, no skips, no second h1, no h2-in-h2.
criteria.evidence: §2c wrapper tags + §2d heading rows in document order
criteria.predicate: count(main)==1 AND count(h1)==1 AND heading_sequence_is_valid_outline

criteria.criterion: Declared section order yields a valid heading sequence and a valid layout flow (no aside before its main, no footer before content).
criteria.predicate: heading_sequence_valid AND layout_flow_valid

criteria.criterion: Every widget named exists in the schema SSOT or has an atomic fixture; every bound prop exists with the recorded $$type envelope.
criteria.predicate: ∀ widget w: w ∈ schema.widgets ∪ fixtures AND ∀ prop p in w: p ∈ schema.widgets[w].props

criteria.criterion: Archetypes and dynamic-heading phrasings match peer-template conventions; any new shape is justified by a peer comparison.
criteria.predicate: ∀ archetype a not in catalog: a has a peer-comparison override

criteria.criterion: The Phase 0 rebuild-vs-revise call is recorded and justified.
criteria.evidence: Plan Document Phase 0 note + wpdev elementor:tree
criteria.predicate: plan.phase0.decision ∈ {rebuild, revise} AND has reason

criteria.criterion: Every information unit on the production page appears in a blueprint cell OR is acknowledged in the §2d Improvements log.
criteria.predicate: set(production_info_units) ⊆ set(blueprint_units ∪ improvement_log_units)

criteria.criterion: Each section's wrapper tag fits its role (section content, aside sidebar, article self-contained, main root only); div at shallow depth is a missed-semantic-tag flag.
criteria.predicate: ∀ section s: s.tag matches its archetype role

criteria.criterion: Column count follows the content hierarchy; more sections over more columns; collapses to one column on small screens.
criteria.predicate: ∀ section s: s.mobile_cols == '1fr' AND grid justified by content

criteria.criterion: Each section's first heading is an h2 naming its purpose; a second line under a heading is that heading row's subtitle cell; no other decorative text is a heading. kind:byline and byline_* cells are migrated-away (step 1336 → kind:heading + subtitle) and any style outside the enum ['', h1..h6, small] (notably label / byline_label) is invalid; both are flagged severity C.
criteria.predicate: ∀ section s: first_heading(s)==h2 AND no decorative h* AND no kind:byline AND no byline_* cell AND style ∈ ['', h1..h6, small]

criteria.criterion: Every widget in a blueprint appears in the §2b Widget Catalog (schema SSOT or atomic fixture).
criteria.predicate: ∀ blueprint widget w: w ∈ §2b catalog

criteria.criterion: Every blueprint row has all mandatory cells filled and a matching Widget-placement row; no blank cell (genuinely-empty → (empty)).
criteria.predicate: ∀ blueprint row r: all_mandatory_cells(r) filled AND ∃ placement_row(r)

criteria.criterion: Every ts-* widget's shape comes from a complete atomic fixture, and every post-ID reference it carries is a live post on the target site.
criteria.predicate: ∀ ts widget: shape from fixture AND ∀ ref_id: post_status(ref_id)=='publish'

criteria.criterion: Every dynamic tag resolves non-empty on the sample (or declares a fallback); affordance switch matches (on for tags, off for literals); $$type envelope matches the SSOT.
criteria.predicate: ∀ dynamic prop p: resolves_nonempty(p) ∨ has_fallback(p); affordance(p)==is_dynamic(p); envelope(p)==schema(p)

criteria.criterion: CPT-template strings wrapped @tags()…@endtags(); _cssid and image refs use the raw vx envelope; static literals are neither.
criteria.predicate: ∀ prop p: is_cpt_string(p) ⇒ tag_wrapped(p); is_cssid_or_image(p) ⇒ vx_envelope(p)

criteria.criterion: Colors, spacing, widths come from design tokens — never hand-authored hex/px/rem literals.
criteria.predicate: ∀ style prop p: value(p) ∈ design_tokens (no raw hex/px/rem)

criteria.criterion: For any SEO-copy authoring build (geo derivation, CPT-single content, bulk excerpt/meta, content-surgery), a claude-seo BASELINE gap-list was captured on the LIVE source page via the Read-fallback BEFORE authoring (seo-local + optionally seo-page/seo-schema). Advisory language does not satisfy this — a written /tmp/BASELINE-<slug>.md gap list must exist.
criteria.evidence: /tmp/BASELINE-<slug>.md plus the native skill name or dynamically resolved seo-local/SKILL.md source path used on the live source URL (references/voxel/claude-seo-authoring.md §1)
criteria.predicate: authoring_build ⇒ exists(/tmp/BASELINE-<slug>.md) AND baseline.gap_list is non-empty

criteria.criterion: Every authored reader/SERP-facing field (h1, hook/meta, description body, faq, conversion-*, post_excerpt) was produced through claude-seo content methodology (Read-fallback of seo-content-brief + seo-local), passing: keyword placement, meta length ≤LEAN_SEO_DESC_LIMIT(155)/target 120–152, stated information-gain vs source, swap-test + ≥500-word/>60%-unique for location pages, E-E-A-T. Not ad-hoc prose.
criteria.evidence: authored field values vs references/voxel/claude-seo-authoring.md §2 checklist; swap-test on the description; word/char counts
criteria.predicate: ∀ authored copy field f: f satisfies {keyword_placement, meta_len≤155, information_gain_stated, swap_test_pass(if location), eeat_signals} AND no fabricated program/stat

criteria.criterion: Every planned _cssid / known selector is present in the DOM.
criteria.predicate: ∀ planned _cssid c: document.querySelector(c) != null

criteria.criterion: No literal @post(...) / @tags() text leaks into the rendered HTML.
criteria.predicate: rendered_html does not match /@(post|tags|author|site)\(/

criteria.criterion: Computed section width, grid tracks, inherited --ef-cols, and hero tag match the Layout map.
criteria.predicate: ∀ section s: computed(s).grid_tracks == plan(s).grid_tracks

criteria.criterion: No console errors and no page errors at runtime.
criteria.predicate: console.errors == [] AND page.errors == []

criteria.criterion: Full screenshot taken AND read — hero present, sections laid out as planned, feeds filled.
criteria.predicate: agent confirms each planned section visually present in the PNG

criteria.criterion: Expected dynamic values appear (render-empty passes iff voxel:data shows the field empty on that post).
criteria.predicate: ∀ dynamic prop p on post: dom_empty(p) ⇒ voxel_data_empty(p)

criteria.criterion: A relation/loop does not self-traverse (a post listing itself in its own related feed).
criteria.predicate: ∀ relation feed f on post: current_post_id ∉ f.results

criteria.criterion: Design-token references resolve (no silent fallback to an unintended default).
criteria.predicate: ∀ token ref t: getComputedStyle resolves t to its token value

criteria.criterion: Feed filters have a matching index-table reindex (feed not silently empty).
criteria.predicate: ∀ filtered feed: index_table populated for its filter fields

criteria.criterion: No u00xx accent corruption in written or rendered text.
criteria.predicate: _elementor_data does NOT match /[a-zA-Z]u00[a-f0-9]{2}/
